entities.name: Nicolau I of Kongo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolau I Misaki mia Nimi was the ruler of the Kingdom of Kongo as a member of the House of Kimpanzu from 1752 until sometime after 1758, during the rotating houses period established by Pedro IV.
